resources.string:
• "Bigger Number" game (really dumb) • user is shown two numbers • click button to choose which one is bigger • correct/incorrect message after each guess • earn points for each correct answer
• We need to learn: • how to create and position graphical widgets • how to respond to user events
Press the button of the larger number. If you get it right, you will earn a point! If you get it wrong, you lose a point.
